archive.catalogue_description: As always hello !! Today with Creep115 we bring a map that he made but to help him modify it. I honestly liked doing it since his maps are great and I said to him .. let’s make your map together. Anyway, this map is its V2 version. I thank Creep115 for allowing me to participate in his map. I am very sorry that you could not put your hud … it is that I don’t know if I will have time to upload the map later but I will surely solve it in an update. DISCLAIMER: YOU DO NOT NEED A SUPER PC TO PLAY THIS MAP. THAT THE MAP HAS GLOSSY FLOORS DOES NOT MEAN THAT THE XD MAP IS RTX. EVEN TOWARDS I GAVE THE PERKS SHINES TO MAKE THEY LOOK PRETTY. What does this version bring back? Weapons from Infinity Warfare and ForgeFreeze, Venom X. Minecraft zombies Infinity Warfare Zombies Perks Different rounds sound Pack A Punch Zone (the zone has background music but is not copyrighted) 6 Bosses Teleports “Sometimes teleports will troll you and they will leave you in the same area where you pressed it .. I did so so that you don’t always depend on them. To go to the pack a punch zone you have to activate all the portals and go To the final portal, you will have 30 seconds! I hope you are lucky !!! Bugs: I swapped the candies for drinks for now. in the future they will have their animation and candies like infinity warfare if possible .. we will see.
